segments.he: מַתְנִי׳ הַנּוֹטֵל שָׂכָר לִהְיוֹת רוֹאֶה אֶת הַבְּכוֹרוֹת — אֵין שׁוֹחֲטִין עַל פִּיו, אֶלָּא אִם כֵּן הָיָה מוּמְחֶה.
segments.en: «MISHNA:» In the case of an individual «who takes payment to be one who examines firstborn» animals to determine whether they are blemished, «one may not slaughter» the firstborn «on the basis of his» ruling, «unless he was an expert»

segments.he: כְּאִילָא בְּיַבְנֶה, שֶׁהִתִּירוּ לוֹ (בְּיַבְנֶה) חֲכָמִים לִהְיוֹת נוֹטֵל אַרְבַּע אִיסָּרוֹת לִבְהֵמָה דַּקָּה, וְשִׁשָּׁה לְגַסָּה, בֵּין תָּם וּבֵין בַּעַל מוּם.
segments.en: «like Ila in Yavne, whom the Sages in Yavne permitted to take» a wage of «four issar for» issuing a ruling concerning «a small animal and six» issar «for» issuing a ruling concerning «a large animal.» They permitted this provided that he would be paid «whether» it turned out that the firstborn was «unblemished or whether» it was «blemished.»

moves.summary: Paid examiner not relied upon unless expert
Example: Ila, permitted fixed fees whether blemished or not

edges.proposedPredicate: social.licenses — «שהתירו לו חכמים» — a body of sages grants a named individual a personal halakhic license; appointed installs to office, said_to is bare speech, rules_like decides between views

positions.claim: one may not slaughter by a paid examiner unless he is an expert like Ila
